hero.tagline: I build reliable APIs and infrastructure that scale.

about.label: ABOUT ME
about.body: I am a backend developer who loves designing clean APIs and solid infrastructure. I studied systems programming at 42Seoul and build services with FastAPI, Spring, and AWS. I care deeply about security, performance, and code that reads well. Currently looking for a team where I can grow as a backend engineer.

backend.title: BACKEND DEVELOPER
backend.subtitle: Designing & building server-side systems
backend.body: REST APIs with FastAPI and Spring, authentication middleware, and data modeling with MySQL and Redis. I focus on secure, well-tested server code.

infra.title: INFRA & DEVOPS
infra.subtitle: Shipping and operating services
infra.body: Containerizing with Docker, deploying to AWS, S3 presigned workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux server operations.

now.label: NOW
now.heading: Building & job hunting
now.body: Sharpening backend skills with personal projects while preparing to join a great engineering team.

2025.heading: Safe Slack API project
2025.body: Designed and built a secure file-sharing API with FastAPI, S3 presigned URLs, and custom auth middleware.

2024.heading: 42Seoul deep dive
2024.body: Completed core curriculum projects covering C, networking, and system programming through peer-to-peer learning.

2023.heading: Started the journey
2023.body: Began studying computer science fundamentals and backend development through an intensive bootcamp.
